headline: Google tells Android app developers to cool it on memory use, or else
summary: Google will enforce new memory-usage limits for Android apps. Play Store will police memory-hungry applications. Developers must meet new restrictions to avoid consequences.

headline: Speedo’s new smart goggles module can track all four swim strokes
summary: Speedo introduces a new smart module for Vanquisher goggles. The iQ system tracks all four swim strokes: freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, butterfly. It analyzes head movement, breath timing, and distance per stroke.

headline: Jensen Huang says Nvidia achieved AGI, again — not that it matters
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claimed the company achieved AGI. He quickly dismissed the milestone as 'senseless.' The industry lacks a consensus definition for AGI, making the claim ambiguous.

headline: Sony finally has a cheaper OLED to compete with midrange Samsung and LG TVs
summary: Sony unveils the new Bravia 6 OLED TV. This model is positioned as a more affordable OLED option. It aims to compete with midrange OLEDs from Samsung and LG.

headline: The LEGO Mario Minifigure Sets Look Like a Much-Needed ‘Reset’ for the Mario Theme
summary: LEGO's new Mario minifigure sets mark a significant change. They offer a 'reset' for the long-running Mario theme. The new designs address past lackluster offerings for kids.

headline: Playdate Manufacturer Panic Is Passing Tariff Refunds to Customers
summary: Panic, maker of the Playdate handheld, is refunding customers. The refunds are for tariffs imposed on the device last year. This follows a Supreme Court order to refund those fees.

headline: Elden Ring Update Patch Notes Reveal Biggest Changes in Years
summary: Elden Ring received a surprise update with major changes. The patch introduces the game's most significant revisions in years. Fans are excited by the extensive new additions and adjustments.

headline: Today’s Top Deals: 007 First Light for PS5, Corsair TC100 Gaming Chair, and Nintendo eShop Gift Card
summary: Discover today's best gaming deals, including 007 First Light for PS5. Save on accessories like the Corsair TC100 Gaming Chair. Find discounts on Nintendo eShop gift cards and other tech.

headline: Watch: Tracing the deadly path of the Nepal-Tibet flash flood
summary: BBC Verify mapped the destructive Nepal-Tibet flash flood. Video evidence was used to trace the flood's deadly path. The report highlights the catastrophic impact of the natural disaster.

headline: Uefa preparing criminal legal action against Infantino
summary: Uefa is pursuing criminal proceedings against Fifa president Gianni Infantino. The action relates to the scrapped plan to sell World Cup stakes. This marks a significant escalation in the ongoing dispute.

headline: The monstrous crimes of Ratko Mladic, the 'Butcher of Bosnia'
summary: Ratko Mladic, known as the 'Butcher of Bosnia', led ethnic cleansing. His campaign occurred during the Bosnian conflict. The article recounts his monstrous crimes and their legacy.

headline: Dame Jenni Murray died days after car crash, inquest hears
summary: Dame Jenni Murray died eight days after a car collision. The former BBC Radio 4 Woman's Hour presenter passed away earlier this year. An inquest is investigating the circumstances surrounding her death.
